libs.heroDesc: A collection of libraries, tools, and projects designed to accelerate computation and optimization research.
libs.empty: No libraries found in the collection.
libs.desc.evox: A distributed GPU-accelerated evolutionary computation framework compatible with PyTorch.
libs.desc.evogit: A decentralized multi-agent framework that reimagines software development as a collaborative, evolutionary process.
libs.desc.evogp: A fully GPU-accelerated Tree-based Genetic Programming (TGP) framework built on PyTorch.
libs.desc.evorl: A fully GPU-accelerated framework for Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning.
libs.desc.evomo: A GPU-accelerated library for evolutionary multiobjective optimization (EMO) via advanced tensorization.
libs.desc.tensorneat: A JAX-based library for NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) algorithms.
libs.desc.metade: An advanced evolutionary framework that dynamically optimizes the strategies and hyperparameters of Differential Evolution.
libs.desc.evoxbench: A platform offering instant benchmarking of evolutionary multi-objective optimization (EMO) algorithms in neural architecture search (NAS).
libs.desc.istratde: A GPU-accelerated Differential Evolution framework that enhances performance through individual-level strategy diversity.
libs.desc.evogo: A fully data-driven framework for black-box optimization, replacing manual heuristic operators by learning search behaviors from historical data.
libs.desc.evonas: A framework for neural architecture search, implemented with PyTorch. It supports supernet training, evolutionary multi-objective optimization, and seamless integration with modern computer vision training pipelines.
libs.desc.evocmo: A fully tensorized, GPU-accelerated multi-population evolutionary algorithm for efficiently solving constrained multi-objective optimization problems (CMOPs).
libs.desc.autopso: A meta-framework for automated Particle Swarm Optimization that automatically constructs PSO variants through black-box optimization on GPUs.
